text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Rhein Kraft blazed through her debut
race. 
Her run was so brilliant and dazzling
that 
it moved her Trainer to the core.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She declared once again that she and her 
Trainer would aim for the Triple Tiara 
together.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And then, the Trainer announces the next 
goal: the GⅠ race, the Hanshin Juvenile 
Fillies.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Diving straight into a GⅠ race without
any prep steps. She feels the tension of 
taking on the grand stage where 
generations of Tiara Umamusume have 
competed.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, placing her faith in the Trainer 
who believed in her, she resolved to set 
her sights on the Hanshin JF.
